title: Local dimension inequality for an integral dominant morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-pc-integral-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth] be a dominant morphism (its image $f(X)$ is dense in $S$) locally of finite type between integral schemes, with $S$ locally Noetherian. For $x\in X$ and $s=f(x)$, let $\eta_S$ and $\eta_X$ be the generic points and write $R(S)=\mathcal O_{S,\eta_S}$ and $R(X)=\mathcal O_{X,\eta_X}$ for their function fields [def-sc-generic-point, def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and write $\kappa(s),\kappa(x)$ for residue fields [def-weil-residue-field, def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Then [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] $$\dim(\mathcal O_{X,x})+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(s)}\kappa(x)\leq\dim(\mathcal O_{S,s})+\operatorname{trdeg}_{R(S)}R(X).$$

source.place: Tag 02JU, lemma-dimension-formula (label lemma-dimension-formula; equation (dimension-formula)); the inequality clause.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-dominant-affine-chart-data] at $x$. It supplies $s\in U$, $x\in V$, $f(V)\subseteq U$, with $A=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_S)$ a Noetherian domain, $B=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)$ a finite type domain over $A$, and an injective map $\varphi:A\to B$. Its generic-stalk identifications identify $R(S)\to R(X)$ with the fraction-field extension of $\varphi$. The hypotheses are exactly dominance, integrality, local finite type, and a locally Noetherian base, all assumed here.

source.place: Tag 02JU, lemma-dimension-formula, reduction to the algebra dimension formula.

proof.text: For the same $f,U,V,x$, apply [lem-trf-affine-local-dimension-term-comparison]. This gives the corresponding primes $\mathfrak p,\mathfrak q$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$, identifies $\dim\mathcal O_{S,s}=\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak p)$ and $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}=\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak q)$, and identifies the two residue-field transcendence degrees and the algebra transcendence degree $\operatorname{trdeg}_A B=\operatorname{trdeg}_{R(S)}R(X)$. Its field maps are the maps induced by $f$, as required in the statement.

source.place: Tag 02JU, lemma-dimension-formula, reduction to the algebra dimension formula.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-affine-dimension-inequality] to $A\subseteq B$ and $\mathfrak p,\mathfrak q$. Step 1 supplies its Noetherian, domain and finite-type hypotheses; Step 2 supplies the contraction condition. Its height inequality, written additively, is $\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak q)+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(\mathfrak p)}\kappa(\mathfrak q)\leq\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak p)+\operatorname{trdeg}_A B$. Substituting the three comparisons from Step 2 gives precisely the asserted additive local dimension inequality.

lean.statement: theorem local_dimension_formula {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral S] (f : X ⟶ S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsDominant f] (x : X) : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) + (Cardinal.toENat (@Algebra.trdeg (S.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) _ _ (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (S.presheaf.stalk (f x)) + (Cardinal.toENat (@Algebra.trdeg S.functionField X.functionField _ _ (Scheme.Hom.dominantFunctionFieldAlgebra f)) : WithBot ℕ∞)
